#### Physicochemical:

+----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                        | **Atracurium**                                | **Cisatracurium**                                               |
+========================================+===============================================+=================================================================+
| Molecule                               | Quaternary amine                              | Quaternary amine                                                |
|                                        |                                               |                                                                 |
|                                        | 4 chiral centres                              | 1Rcis-1R’cis stereoisomer of atracurium                         |
|                                        |                                               |                                                                 |
|                                        | 10 stereoisomers (n2 = 16 but some identical) | R: stereochemistry of the benzyltetrahydroisoquinoline rings    |
|                                        |                                               |                                                                 |
|                                        | 15% cisatracurium = 50% activity              | Cis: geometry of the bulky methoxy at C1 and 2-alkylester at N1 |
+----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| Needs reconstitution                   | N                                             | N                                                               |
|                                        |                                               |                                                                 |
| (i.e. easy use)                        |                                               |                                                                 |
+----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| Needs refrigeration                    | Y 2-8°C                                       | Y 2-8°C                                                         |
+----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| Life at room temp (accept 90% potency) | 2/52                                          | 3/52                                                            |
+----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| Compatibility                          | No precipitation                              | No precipitation                                                |
|                                        |                                               |                                                                 |
|                                        | pH 4                                          | pH 4                                                            |
+----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+

|                             | IV only                                                | IV only           |
